stem_md: 设 $z$ 为曲面 $2x^2+3y^2+z^2=6$ 在 $P(1,1,1)$ 处指向外侧的法向量，求 $u=\frac1z(6x^2+8y^2)^{1/2}$ 沿此法向的方向导数。
analysis_md:
令 $F(x,y,z)=2x^2+3y^2+z^2-6$，

$$F_x|_P=4x|_P=4，\quad F_y|_P=6y|_P=6，\quad F_z|_P=2z|_P=2，$$

故 $\vec{n}=\{F_x,F_y,F_z\}|_P，\quad |\vec{n}|=\sqrt{4^2+6^2+2^2}=2\sqrt{14}，$

方向余弦为：$\cos\alpha=\frac{2}{\sqrt{14}}，\quad \cos\beta=\frac{3}{\sqrt{14}}，\quad \cos\gamma=\frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}$

$$\left.\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right|_P=\left.\frac{6x}{z\sqrt{6x^2+8y^2}}\right|_P=\frac{6}{\sqrt{14}}，\quad \left.\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right|_P=\left.\frac{8y}{z\sqrt{6x^2+8y^2}}\right|_P=\frac{8}{\sqrt{14}}；$$

$$\left.\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\right|_P=\left.-\frac{\sqrt{6x^2+8y^2}}{z^2}\right|_P=-\sqrt{14}；$$

所以 $\left.\frac{\partial u}{\partial\vec{n}}\right|_P=\left.\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\cos\alpha+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\cos\beta+\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\cos\gamma\right)\right|_P=\frac{11}{7}。$
